battles §4.5 (fog, spec §2): how well the crown's own men count the enemy's fallen in a battle letter, a spy quality 0..999+ for SpySystem.estimate (1000 = the narrowest span, spy_width_best); the letter never gives a foe regiment's exact losses, morale or strength
defeat (spec §4.5): share of the crown's treasury lost when a town falls, per mille (first draft)
defeat: the realm-wide morale lost when a town falls, whole points (first draft)
defeat: opinion points each council seat loses on a lost town, before its ideology and temper scale it (first draft)
enemy AI (spec §3.2): a host chooses its target again every this many days (first draft)
enemy AI (spec §3): a host sees the player's regiments and towns only this far (first draft)
enemy AI §3.3: candidate targets lie within this many km of the host (first draft)

enemy AI §3.3: the share of its score, per mille, a target loses when another (non-reserve) host has already chosen it; 1000 is a BAN: it scores 0 and EnemyAi.rank never takes a target at 0, so two hosts never share one (controller ruling, Task 7 review)
enemy AI §3.4: a host with fewer days of supply than this retreats (first draft)

enemy AI §3.5: a host chooses no target more march days away than its days in hand less ai_retreat_supply_days less this margin (EnemyAi.supply_reach_days): days_in_hand rounds down and the whole-unit daily meals can eat a unit more than the even share, so a target at the bare horizon would turn the host home at the gate (Default, controller ruling Task 8 review)

siege (spec §5.1): siege_progress (of 1000) a day = siege_rate x A / (A + D), A the besiegers' attack, D the garrison's defence (works in it). 100: one militia regiment in an open town falls inside ten days to the main host; three in a walled town with a citadel outlast its ~20 days of supply (Task 9 tuning, test_siege)
siege: a host assaults the town every this many days (first draft)
siege: how much faster a town whose stores are spent falls, per mille over siege_rate (first draft)
siege (spec §5.1): the siege_progress (of 1000) a host loses for each assault round of a tier whose battle_outcomes.csv siege column is repulsed (attacker_checked) (Default, Task 9)

siege (spec §5.2, manor-level capture): a fallen town's own manor and its province's manors whose centre lies within this many km of the town go to the raider's house while its host holds the town; on the first pack about the town's manor and one neighbour (Default, Task 9 fix round 1)
invasion: the border rumour reaches the crown this many days before raid_appear_day (first draft)

raids (spec §5.3, RaidSystem): share of a plundered manor's month (ManorEconomy.line_of tax + goods' worth) a host takes, per mille, a thirtieth a day on the running sum; the most one manor gives (first draft)

raids (spec §5.3, RaidSystem): the share of a day's take, per mille, a raiding host turns into food for its columns, at a supply unit's gold (army_supply_gold_permille), never past army_supply_max_days carried; the rest is its plunder. 200: the host eats more than the raid feeds it, so it stays in the field past its own stores but still goes home — in the no-orders run the main host raids an open town from day 17 and another from day 39 and turns home on day 49 (the raiders, sitting down before a camped town on day 59, on day 72). 300 was tried: the main host nearly fed itself and roamed on from town to town with no end (Default, Task 10)
